## Public research release checklist

**Warning:** This pull request, its commits, diffs and prior revisions are **publicly visible**. Do not use public PRs for confidential review or an unpublished manuscript.

- [ ] The exact candidate has already passed private scientific and factual review.
- [ ] Qualified IP/patent and security review found no disclosure risk, including inferential reconstruction.
- [ ] Privacy, authorship, rights, image and data permissions were checked.
- [ ] No proprietary mechanisms, source, internal paths, configurations, experimental results, secrets or credentials are present.
- [ ] Manuscript status, citations, limitations, and peer-review state are accurate.
- [ ] Publication identifier, version, DOI (if any), copyright/license and intended public path were verified.
- [ ] Founder approved **this exact release revision and destination**.
- [ ] Public paper index and links will be updated after publication readback.
- [ ] No schedule, workflow or cross-platform syndication is being enabled without its own explicit authority.

**Public-safe release identifier:**  
**Release version:**  
**Approval already completed outside public GitHub:** YES / NO  
**Reviewer outcome:** APPROVED PUBLIC-SAFE / BLOCKED

If any item is unresolved, close the PR and return to private review. Deleting a public PR is not a confidentiality remedy.
